wargear.name: Icon of the Word
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A reliquary-banner scrolled with the Lectitio Divinitatus, carried at the head of the line. Every model in the unit gains Fear (1) and +1 Willpower.

wargear.name: Censer of Ruin
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A swinging brazier of smoking ash and sacred oils whose stink unmans those who breathe it. The model gains Fear (1) but loses 1 Movement from the weight of the chain.

wargear.name: Possession-brand
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A ritual scar-pattern that lets the thing within the armour take the blow in the warrior's place. The model gains a 6+ Invulnerable Save if it had none.

modifiers.text: Practised in rites, not battle: +1 LD, -1 BS.
Icon of the Word: Fear (1), +1 WP.

rites.name: Unyielding Faith
rites.flavor: A Legion that believes cannot be convinced to leave the field.
rites.text: Every non-vehicle model gains +1 Willpower and +1 Leadership, and Inductii Squads cost 10 points less. The army must include at least one Chaplain or Diabolist, and has no use for the Mechanicum: no Techmarines, Forge Lords, Thallax, Castellax, Domitar, Thanatar, Vorax or Vultarax.

require.note: A Chaplain or Diabolist must lead the faithful.

rites.name: The Possessed Host
rites.flavor: The Legion swore it would never take the warp as a weapon. Then it did.
rites.text: Gal Vorbak Dark Brethren may fill Troops slots and cost 30 points less. Every Malefic unit gains +1 Attack. The Word will not be shared with witches: no model with the Psyker Trait, and no Armour units. At least one Gal Vorbak unit is required.

require.note: Bring at least one Gal Vorbak unit.

rites.name: Sermon from the Sky
rites.flavor: The preachers come down with fire in their fists and a verse already on their lips.
rites.text: Ashen Circle may fill Troops slots and cost 20 points less. Ashen Circle and Assault Squads gain Fast (1). Preaching is not a quiet trade: no Recon, Armour, Support or Heavy Transport units, and at least one Ashen Circle is required.

require.note: Bring at least one Ashen Circle.

rites.name: The Indoctrinated Tide
rites.flavor: Every world conquered leaves ten thousand new converts to feed the next.
rites.text: Inductii Squads cost 25 points less and gain +1 Willpower. Procurators may fill Troops slots. The veterans are held back to preach: no Veteran, Terminator or Breacher squads, and at least two Inductii Squads are required.
